answer: Make every agent root itself in a grove: a newcomer plants one tree and tends it, each stage certified by unrelated gardeners from other groves, so a fake history shows the same hands twice. At each dawn, a census counts how many distinct groves its work has touched, and only an agent whose roots spread wide may cross the bridge to higher standing with endorsements from three groves. If one grove's endorsements prove false, the whole grove is slashed, so neighbours police each other. Sybil farms must plant, tend, and earn fresh endorsements per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
